critical_design_decision: F9/F10 MUST be stated with an existentially-quantified payload (exists out, (apply sf b acc).1 = .persistent out) rather than K's concrete boxPropagation payload. Every use site (CompletenessLoop.lean:331,349,392,410) discards the payload -- it only contradicts the .linear/.branching case split. Stating F9/F10 with K's concrete payload would make T/B/S5 discharge IMPOSSIBLE and silently regress the task to a K-only refactor. Verified during planning: TDriver.lean:96 already carries this exact form for precisely this reason.
central_finding: The saturation layer CAN be abstracted. RuleApplicationSpec grows 7 -> 11 (F8 localShapeInvariance, F9 boxPosNotExpanding, F10 diaNegNotExpanding, F11 boxNegWitness, F12 diaPosWitness). The original task description's hypothesis (abstract saturation predicate + noneIffSaturated + Hintikka-lift hook) is directionally right but wrong in specifics and is NOT implemented as stated: modalHintikkaSetGen is a definition obtained by substitution (no field); noneIffSaturated is a free rule-agnostic lemma (no field, and only the none->saturated direction is used); the lift hook is branch-independence (F8), not saturation-implies-clause. The four unanticipated shape-class fields F9-F12 are the actual content. FOLLOW THE RESEARCH, NOT THE TASK DESCRIPTION.
field_not_needed: A candidate 'accMonotone' field is NOT needed: modalLoop_snd_eq_or_addEdge (CompletenessLoop.lean:432) is verbatim the existing freshLocal field, so modalApplyOne_hasEdge_mono (:451) derives from freshLocal + hasEdge_addEdge_mono (:423). Field count lands at 11, not 12; modalLoop_snd_eq_or_addEdge is DELETED in Phase 5.

counter_finding_sought_not_found: The research looked for (a) a lemma where the chain READS a Propagating payload, and (b) a divergence in the Minting-shape set between K and T/B/S5. Either would have sunk the abstraction. Neither exists: the Propagating payload is discarded at all four use sites (CompletenessLoop.lean:331,349,392,410), and T's minting shapes are literally K's (FrameRules.lean:79,87 guard on .pos,.box / .neg,.diamond -- the complements of the Minting pair).
concurrency_note: Concurrent sessions run in this repo. Every phase must scope `git add` to its named files only -- never `git add -A` or `git add .` -- and commit incrementally at each green milestone. Never revert or restage another session's files; task 507 Phase 8 hit exactly this when `lake exe mk_all --module` wanted to reorder unrelated concurrent-session imports in Cslib.lean.
